people.name: Kyle Robert Spahn
people.bio_note: Founder and sole Managing Member of Spahn Wealth & Retirement; roughly 18-20 years as a financial planner. Holds the CFP designation and a degree from Arizona State University. Built the firm around long-term client relationships and retirement planning, with an investment approach grounded in Modern Portfolio Theory with tactical adjustments.
